newsitem.title: USA: TCI may take partners to cut debt - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: TCI may take partners to cut debt - WSJ.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc night seek new financial partners or create joint ventures with other cable operators to try to cut its debt, the Wall Street Journal said in its Tuesday electronic edition.

President Leo Hindery told analysts the company would also kill an earlier plan to separate its cable operations into three units and different service levels, and instead divide operations into units grouped by region, the report said.
The report said the company also plans to have Brendan Clouston, who has been responsible for core cable operations, fill the now-vacant position of chief financial officer.
